_readme: Weekly working list of sailings. Add one object per sailing to "sailings". Fields: loadPort, destination, vessel, voyage, carrier, ets (departure), eta (arrival), lane, notes. Dates must be YYYY-MM-DD. Transit time is calculated from ets/eta, do not enter it. Rows with "example": true are demo rows - delete them once real sailings are in. Bump "updated" whenever you refresh the list. "lanes" is the carrier lane directory used for the reference links lower down the page.

source.name: Carrier schedules
source.note: Sources: NMT lane schedules (updated 21/08/2026), Grimaldi Tilbury to West Africa (published 12/08/2026, includes RoRo cut-offs), "K" Line Europe to North America and Mexico Gulf, Geest Line Q3 2026 (Portsmouth departures with UK cut-offs and per-port Caribbean arrival dates, decoded from the published schedule and validated against the service’s weekly cadence), plus a residue from Autoshippers destination pages where the ETA is derived from published transit times. All dates are carrier estimates; reconfirm before committing a booking.
